# One formula per line, optionally after setup statements and ``;;``.
# Each probe gets a freshly added worksheet; its formula is written to
# H1 and what that cell shows is recorded.  Setups write into A1:F10.
#
# Measured in live Excel by ``python scripts/measure_vba_semantics.py
# formula`` and replayed against the engine by tests/test_formula.py.

# --- operators and what they do to the types ---
=1+2
=1+2*3
=(1+2)*3
=2^3
=2^3^2
=-2^2
=2^-1
=10/4
=10/0
=5-"2"
="5"+1
="a"+1
=1&2
=1.5&"x"
=TRUE&"x"
="a"&""
=50%
=50%+1
=2^3%
=-3%
=1=1
=1="1"
=1<"1"
="a"="A"
="a"<"b"
="b"<"a"
=TRUE>"z"
=TRUE=1
=TRUE+TRUE
=1<>2
="">""
=1/3
=(1/3)*3
=0.1+0.2
=0.1+0.2=0.3
=1E+15
=1E+16
=1/3*3=1

# --- an empty cell ---
;; =A1
;; =A1+1
;; =A1&"x"
;; =A1=0
;; =A1=""
;; =ISBLANK(A1)
;; =COUNT(A1)
;; =COUNTA(A1)
;; =SUM(A1:A3)
;; =AVERAGE(A1:A3)
Range("A1").Value = 0 ;; =ISBLANK(A1)

# --- what a range contributes, and what a literal does ---
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = "2" ;; =SUM(A1:A2)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = TRUE ;; =SUM(A1:A2)
Range("A1").Value = 1 ;; =SUM(A1,"2")
Range("A1").Value = 1 ;; =SUM(A1,TRUE)
Range("A1").Value = 1 ;; =SUM(A1,"x")
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = "2" ;; =COUNT(A1:A2)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = "2" ;; =COUNTA(A1:A2)
Range("A1:A3").Value = 2 ;; =PRODUCT(A1:A3)
Range("A1").Value = 3: Range("A2").Value = 1: Range("A3").Value = 2 ;; =MAX(A1:A3)
Range("A1").Value = 3: Range("A2").Value = 1: Range("A3").Value = 2 ;; =MIN(A1:A3)&"/"&MEDIAN(A1:A3)
Range("A1").Value = 3: Range("A2").Value = 1: Range("A3").Value = 2 ;; =LARGE(A1:A3,2)&"/"&SMALL(A1:A3,2)
Range("A1:A2").Value = 1 ;; =AVERAGE(A1:A2)
;; =AVERAGE(A1:A2)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 3 ;; =STDEV(A1:A2)&"/"&STDEVP(A1:A2)
;; =STDEV(1,6,7,8)
;; =STDEVP(1,6,7,8,9)
;; =VAR(0.1,0.2,0.3)
;; =VARP(0.1,0.2,0.3,0.7)
;; =STDEV(1,6,7,8)*1E+15
;; =VAR(1,6,7,8)*1E+15
;; =VAR(0.1,0.2,0.3)-0.01
;; =VAR(0.3,0.2,0.1)-0.01
;; =VARP(0.1,0.2,0.3)-0.0066666666666667
;; =STDEV(1,6,7,8)-3.1091263510296
;; =STDEV(0.1,0.2,0.3)-0.1
;; =VAR(1000000001,1000000002,1000000003)-1
;; =VAR(0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4)-0.0166666666666667
;; =VAR(1.1,2.2,3.3)-1.21
;; =VARP(1.1,2.2,3.3)-0.806666666666667
;; =VAR(0.1,0.7)-0.18
;; =VAR(10.1,10.2,10.3)-0.01
;; =VAR(100.1,100.2,100.3)-0.01
;; =VAR(1E+15+1,1E+15+2,1E+15+3)
;; =VAR(0.1,0.2,0.3,0.7,1.1,1.3)-0.2
;; =STDEVP(2.5,3.5,4.5,9.5)-2.7726341266023
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("B1").Value = 2: Range("A2").Value = 3: Range("B2").Value = 4 ;; =SUMPRODUCT(A1:A2,B1:B2)

# --- rounding, which is not VBA's ---
=ROUND(2.5,0)
=ROUND(-2.5,0)
=ROUND(0.5,0)
=ROUND(1.5,0)
=ROUND(2.675,2)
=ROUND(1234.5678,-2)
=ROUNDUP(1.1,0)
=ROUNDDOWN(1.9,0)
=ROUNDUP(-1.1,0)
=ROUNDDOWN(-1.9,0)
=INT(-1.5)
=INT(1.5)
=TRUNC(-1.9)
=MOD(7,3)
=MOD(-7,3)
=MOD(7,-3)
=MOD(7,0)
=MROUND(7,3)
=CEILING(7,3)
=FLOOR(7,3)
=ABS(-3)
=SIGN(-3)
=SQRT(9)
=SQRT(-1)
=POWER(2,10)
=EXP(1)
=LN(1)
=LOG(8,2)
=LOG10(100)
=PI()

# --- the criteria functions ---
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 5: Range("A3").Value = 10 ;; =COUNTIF(A1:A3,">4")
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 5: Range("A3").Value = 10 ;; =SUMIF(A1:A3,">4")
Range("A1").Value = "a": Range("A2").Value = "b": Range("B1").Value = 1: Range("B2").Value = 2 ;; =SUMIF(A1:A2,"a",B1:B2)
Range("A1").Value = "a": Range("A2").Value = "A" ;; =COUNTIF(A1:A2,"a")
Range("A1").Value = "apple": Range("A2").Value = "apricot" ;; =COUNTIF(A1:A2,"ap*")
Range("A1").Value = "apple": Range("A2").Value = "apricot" ;; =COUNTIF(A1:A2,"a?p*")
Range("A1").Value = "a": Range("A2").Value = "b" ;; =COUNTIF(A1:A2,"<>a")
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2: Range("B1").Value = "x": Range("B2").Value = "y" ;; =SUMIFS(A1:A2,B1:B2,"y")
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2: Range("B1").Value = "x": Range("B2").Value = "x" ;; =COUNTIFS(A1:A2,">0",B1:B2,"x")
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 3 ;; =AVERAGEIF(A1:A2,">2")
Range("A1").Value = 1 ;; =COUNTIF(A1:A3,"")
Range("A1").Value = 1 ;; =COUNTBLANK(A1:A3)

# --- lookups ---
Range("A1").Value = "a": Range("B1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = "b": Range("B2").Value = 2 ;; =VLOOKUP("b",A1:B2,2,FALSE)
Range("A1").Value = "a": Range("B1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = "b": Range("B2").Value = 2 ;; =VLOOKUP("B",A1:B2,2,FALSE)
Range("A1").Value = "a": Range("B1").Value = 1 ;; =VLOOKUP("z",A1:B2,2,FALSE)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("B1").Value = "x": Range("A2").Value = 5: Range("B2").Value = "y" ;; =VLOOKUP(3,A1:B2,2)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("B1").Value = "x": Range("A2").Value = 5: Range("B2").Value = "y" ;; =VLOOKUP(3,A1:B2,2,TRUE)
Range("A1").Value = "a": Range("A2").Value = "b" ;; =MATCH("b",A1:A2,0)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 5 ;; =MATCH(3,A1:A2)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 5 ;; =MATCH(3,A1:A2,0)
Range("A1").Value = "a": Range("B1").Value = "b" ;; =HLOOKUP("b",A1:B1,1,FALSE)
Range("A1:B2").Value = 7 ;; =INDEX(A1:B2,2,2)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2 ;; =INDEX(A1:A2,2)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2 ;; =INDEX(A1:A2,3)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2 ;; =SUM(INDEX(A1:A2,0))
=CHOOSE(2,"a","b","c")
=CHOOSE(0,"a")
;; =ROW()
;; =COLUMN()
;; =ROWS(A1:A5)&"/"&COLUMNS(A1:C1)
Range("A1").Value = 9 ;; =OFFSET(A1,0,0)
Range("B2").Value = 9 ;; =OFFSET(A1,1,1)
Range("A1:A3").Value = 2 ;; =SUM(OFFSET(A1,0,0,3,1))
Range("A1").Value = 5 ;; =INDIRECT("A1")
Range("A1").Value = 5 ;; =INDIRECT("A"&1)
=INDIRECT("nonsense")

# --- logic ---
=IF(TRUE,"y","n")
=IF(FALSE,"y","n")
=IF(FALSE,"y")
=IF(1,"y","n")
=IF("x","y","n")
=IF(TRUE,,"n")
=AND(TRUE,1)
=AND(TRUE,0)
=OR(FALSE,0)
=NOT(0)
=XOR(TRUE,TRUE,TRUE)
=AND(TRUE,"x")
=AND(FALSE,"x")
=AND("x")
=AND("")
=OR(FALSE,"x")
=OR(TRUE,"x")
=XOR(TRUE,"x")
=AND(TRUE,"FALSE")
=OR(FALSE,"TRUE")
=AND("TRUE")
=AND(TRUE,"1")
=OR(FALSE,"1")
=IF(TRUE,)&"x"
=CHOOSE(1,)&"x"
;; =AND(A1:A2)
=IFERROR(1/0,"caught")
=IFERROR(1,"caught")
=IFNA(NA(),"gone")
=IFNA(1/0,"gone")
=ISERROR(1/0)
=ISERR(NA())
=ISNA(NA())
=ERROR.TYPE(1/0)
=NA()
=IFS(FALSE,1,TRUE,2)
=SWITCH(2,1,"a",2,"b","z")

# --- text ---
=LEN("abc")
=LEN(123)
=LEFT("abc",2)
=LEFT("abc")
=RIGHT("abc",5)
=MID("abcdef",3,2)
=MID("abc",5,2)
=TRIM("  a   b  ")
=UPPER("aB")&LOWER("aB")&PROPER("hello world")
=CONCATENATE("a","b")
=CONCAT("a","b")
=TEXTJOIN("-",TRUE,"a","","b")
=TEXTJOIN("-",FALSE,"a","","b")
=SUBSTITUTE("aaa","a","b")
=SUBSTITUTE("aaa","a","b",2)
=REPLACE("abcdef",2,3,"X")
=FIND("b","abc")
=FIND("B","abc")
=SEARCH("B","abc")
=SEARCH("b*","abc")
=FIND("z","abc")
=REPT("ab",3)
=EXACT("a","A")
=CHAR(65)&CODE("A")
=VALUE("1.5")
=VALUE("x")
=VALUE("50%")
=TEXT(1234.5,"#,##0.00")
=TEXT(0.5,"0%")
=TEXT(44000,"yyyy-mm-dd")
=T("a")&"|"&T(1)
=N("a")&"|"&N(TRUE)
=TYPE("a")&TYPE(1)&TYPE(TRUE)

=DATEVALUE("2021-03-04")
=DATE(2021,3,4)-DATE(2021,3,1)

=1/0+1

=#N/A
=#REF!
=1+#VALUE!
=NONSENSEFUNCTION(1)
=UNKNOWNNAME

# --- arrays ---
=SUM({1,2,3})
=SUM({1,2;3,4})
={1,2}+{10,20}
=INDEX({1,2;3,4},2,1)

=TRANSPOSE({1,2})

# --- how a formula moves when it is written to a block ---
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2: Range("B1:B2").Formula = "=A1*10" ;; =B2
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2: Range("B1:B2").Formula = "=$A$1*10" ;; =B2
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("B1").Value = 2: Range("A2:B2").Formula = "=A1*10" ;; =B2
Range("A1").Value = 5: Range("B1").Formula = "=A1": Range("B1").Copy Range("C2") ;; =FORMULATEXT(C2)

# --- a sixteenth digit that ties, as text and in a comparison ---
# A number typed into a formula keeps fifteen significant digits, so the
# ties themselves are written to cells from VBA, which keeps every bit.
Range("A1").Value = 4503599627370495# ;; =A1&""
Range("A1").Value = -4503599627370495# ;; =A1&""
Range("A1").Value = 4503599627370505# ;; =A1&""
Range("A1").Value = -4503599627370505# ;; =A1&""
Range("A1").Value = 123456789012345.5 ;; =A1&""
Range("A1").Value = -123456789012345.5 ;; =A1&""
Range("A1").Value = 4503599627370505#: Range("A2").Value = 4503599627370510# ;; =A1=A2
Range("A1").Value = -4503599627370505#: Range("A2").Value = -4503599627370510# ;; =A1=A2
Range("A1").Value = 4503599627370495#: Range("A2").Value = 4503599627370500# ;; =A1=A2
Range("A1").Value = -4503599627370495#: Range("A2").Value = -4503599627370500# ;; =A1=A2
Range("A1").Value = 4503599627370495#: Range("A2").Value = 4503599627370490# ;; =A1=A2
Range("A1").Value = -4503599627370495#: Range("A2").Value = -4503599627370490# ;; =A1=A2
Range("A1").Value = 123456789012345.5: Range("A2").Value = 123456789012346# ;; =A1=A2
Range("A1").Value = -123456789012345.5: Range("A2").Value = -123456789012346# ;; =A1=A2
Range("A1").Value = 4503599627370495# ;; =A1=4503599627370490
=""&4503599627370495
=""&-4503599627370495
=""&4503599627370505
=""&-4503599627370505
=""&123456789012345.5
=""&-123456789012345.5
=""&123456789012346.5
=""&-123456789012346.5
=EXACT(4503599627370495,4503599627370490)
=4503599627370505=4503599627370510
=-4503599627370505=-4503599627370510
=4503599627370495=4503599627370500
=-4503599627370495=-4503599627370500
=123456789012345.5=123456789012346
=-123456789012345.5=-123456789012346
=123456789012346.5=123456789012347
=-123456789012346.5=-123456789012347

# --- a range or an array where a function wants one value ---
# A range is cut to the cell in the formula's own row or column, as @A1:A3
# would be; an array written out, or an array a function answers, is run
# through item by item. The formulas sit in rows other than the probe's.
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("x", "yy", "zzz")): Range("H2").Formula = "=LEN(A1:A3)" ;; =H2
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("x", "yy", "zzz")): Range("H3").Formula = "=LEN(A1:A3)" ;; =H3
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("x", "yy", "zzz")): Range("H5").Formula = "=LEN(A1:A3)" ;; =H5
Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("x", "yy", "zzz"): Range("B4").Formula = "=LEN(A1:C1)" ;; =B4
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("x", "yy", "zzz")): Range("H2").Formula = "=UPPER(A1:A3)" ;; =H2
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("x", "yy", "zzz")): Range("H2").Formula = "=SUM(LEN(A1:A3))" ;; =H2
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("x", "yy", "zzz")): Range("H2").Formula = "=SUMPRODUCT(LEN(A1:A3))" ;; =H2
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1.4, 2.6, 3.5)): Range("H3").Formula = "=SUM(ROUND(A1:A3,0))" ;; =H3
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1.4, 2.6, 3.5)): Range("H3").Formula = "=SUMPRODUCT(ROUND(A1:A3,0))" ;; =H3
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3)): Range("H2").Formula = "=SUM(IF(A1:A3>1,A1:A3,0))" ;; =H2
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3)): Range("H2").Formula = "=SUMPRODUCT((A1:A3>1)*A1:A3)" ;; =H2
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3)): Range("H2").Formula = "=A1:A3*10" ;; =H2
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3)): Range("H2").Formula = "=ABS(-A1:A3)" ;; =H2
=SUM(LEN({"a","bb","ccc"}))

Range("A1:B3").Value = Array(1, "one"): Range("A2:B2").Value = Array(2, "two"): Range("A3:B3").Value = Array(3, "three") ;; =VLOOKUP({2,3},A1:B3,2,FALSE)

=SUM(DATE(2020,{1,2},1))
=SUM(SUMIF({1,2,3},{1,3}))
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, "a", 3)): Range("H2").Formula = "=ISNUMBER(A1:A3)" ;; =H2
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("a", "b", "a")): Range("H3").Formula = "=COUNTIF(A1:A3,A1:A3)" ;; =H3
